package grantround

import (
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

type ledger struct {
	addrs  []address
	before []int64
}

func snapshot(addrs ...address) ledger {
	l := ledger{addrs: addrs}
	for _, a := range addrs {
		l.before = append(l.before, bal(a))
	}
	return l
}

// delta returns the balance change of a since the snapshot.
func (l ledger) delta(a address) int64 {
	for i, x := range l.addrs {
		if x == a {
			return bal(a) - l.before[i]
		}
	}
	panic("address not in snapshot")
}

func everyone() ledger { return snapshot(customer, s1, s2, s3, p0, p1, pkgAddr) }

func finalizeAs(cur realm, a address, id int) {
	testing.SetRealm(user(a))
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
}

// sheets commits each ev,scores pair, then opens them all in the sheet reveal
// phase and moves past HSheetReveal (round heights h0+11 -> h0+51).
func sheets(cur realm, id int, pairs ...string) {
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(pairs); i += 2 {
		commit(cur, id, address(pairs[i]), pairs[i+1])
	}
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	for i := 0; i+1 < len(pairs); i += 2 {
		openSheet(cur, id, address(pairs[i]), pairs[i+1])
	}
	testing.SkipHeights(10)
}

func TestFinalizePaid(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	sheets(cur, id, e1.String(), "5,5;6,0", e2.String(), "4,0;6,2", e3.String(), "1,0;9,0")
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.True(t, r.Paid && r.Winner == 1 && !r.Cancelled, "paid to app 1")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant, l.delta(p1))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(p0))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s2))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s3))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 3*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

func TestFinalizeSlashesMissingEvaluator(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	sheets(cur, id, e1.String(), "5,5;6,0", e2.String(), "4,0;6,2")
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Paid, "quorum of 2 met")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant, l.delta(p1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s2))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond-tSlash, l.delta(s3))
	uassert.Equal(t, tSlash, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 3*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

func TestFinalizeCancelNoRule(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := ruleRound(cur) // e1, e2 joined; e3 listed only
	l := everyone()
	testing.SkipHeights(10) // past HRule
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.True(t, r.Cancelled && r.Finalized, "cancelled")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s2))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(s3))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 2*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

func TestFinalizeCancelNoReveal(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := adoptedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	l := everyone()
	testing.SkipHeights(20) // past HReveal
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Cancelled, "cancelled")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s3))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 3*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

func TestFinalizeQuorumNotMet(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 3, "lowest")
	sheets(cur, id, e1.String(), "5,5;6,0")
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	uassert.False(t, mustGet(id).Paid, "not paid")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(p0)+l.delta(p1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant+2*tSlash, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond-tSlash, l.delta(s2))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 3*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

func TestFinalizeTieRefund(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 1, "refund")
	sheets(cur, id, e1.String(), "2,0;1,3")
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	uassert.False(t, mustGet(id).Paid, "tie refunded")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant+2*tSlash, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(p0)+l.delta(p1))
}

func TestFinalizeOnceAndNotEarly(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 1, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "cannot be finalized yet", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) }, "score phase")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	openSheet(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "cannot be finalized yet", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) }, "sheet reveal phase")

	testing.SkipHeights(10)
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	Finalize(cross(cur), id)
	l := everyone()
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already finalized", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(p0))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), l.delta(pkgAddr))
}

// A commitment that is never opened is a missed mandate: the bond is slashed and
// the hidden sheet (which would flip the winner) is not counted.
func TestFinalizeSlashesUnopenedCommitment(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	commit(cur, id, e2, "4,0;6,2")
	commit(cur, id, e3, "10,10;0,0")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	openSheet(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	openSheet(cur, id, e2, "4,0;6,2")
	testing.SkipHeights(10)
	l := everyone()
	before := TrackOf(e3)
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.True(t, r.Paid && r.Winner == 1, "only opened sheets count")
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s1))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond, l.delta(s2))
	uassert.Equal(t, tBond-tSlash, l.delta(s3))
	uassert.Equal(t, tSlash, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, -(tGrant + 3*tBond), l.delta(pkgAddr))
	after := TrackOf(e3)
	uassert.Equal(t, before.Accepted+1, after.Accepted)
	uassert.Equal(t, before.Fulfilled, after.Fulfilled)
	uassert.Equal(t, before.Missed+1, after.Missed)
}

func TestFinalizeQuorumCountsOpenedSheets(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	commit(cur, id, e2, "4,0;6,2")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	openSheet(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SkipHeights(10)
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)
	uassert.False(t, mustGet(id).Paid, "one opened sheet of quorum 2")
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant+2*tSlash, l.delta(customer))
}

// A round nobody scores settles only after HSheetReveal: refund and full slashing.
func TestFinalizeNoSheets(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 1, "lowest")
	testing.SkipHeights(39) // h0+50 == HSheetReveal
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "cannot be finalized yet", func() { Finalize(cross(cur), id) }, "at HSheetReveal")
	testing.SkipHeights(1)
	l := everyone()
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant+3*tSlash, l.delta(customer))
	uassert.Equal(t, 3*(tBond-tSlash), l.delta(s1)+l.delta(s2)+l.delta(s3))
}

package grantround

import (
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func assertTrack(t *testing.T, a address, acc, ful, miss int, name string) {
	tr := TrackOf(a)
	uassert.True(t, tr.Accepted == acc && tr.Fulfilled == ful && tr.Missed == miss,
		name+": got "+tr.String())
}

func TestTrackAfterSettlement(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	f1, f2, f3 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-f1"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-f2"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-f3")
	sf1, sf2 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-sf1"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-sf2")
	id, _ := newRound(cur, f1, sf1, f2, sf2, f3, f3)
	joinAll(cur, id, f1, sf1, f2, sf2, f3, f3) // f3 sponsors itself
	assertTrack(t, f1, 0, 0, 0, "f1 before finalize")

	testing.SkipHeights(11)
	testing.SetRealm(user(f1))
	seq := ProposeRule(cross(cur), id, "weighted", "a:1", 1, "lowest", "")
	testing.SetRealm(user(f2))
	ApproveRule(cross(cur), id, seq)
	testing.SetRealm(user(f3))
	ApproveRule(cross(cur), id, seq)
	testing.SetRealm(user(customer))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, testAppsEncoded(), tSalt)
	sheets(cur, id, f1.String(), "1;2", f3.String(), "3;1")
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)

	assertTrack(t, f1, 1, 1, 0, "f1")
	assertTrack(t, sf1, 1, 1, 0, "sf1")
	assertTrack(t, f2, 1, 0, 1, "f2")
	assertTrack(t, sf2, 1, 0, 1, "sf2")
	assertTrack(t, f3, 1, 1, 0, "f3 self-sponsored counts once")
}

func TestTrackUnchangedOnCancel(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	h1, sh1 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-h1"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-sh1")
	id, _ := newRound(cur, h1, sh1)
	joinAll(cur, id, h1, sh1)
	testing.SkipHeights(21) // past HRule with no rule
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)
	assertTrack(t, h1, 0, 0, 0, "h1")
	assertTrack(t, sh1, 0, 0, 0, "sh1")
}

// Join opens empty records, paid by the sponsor, so that Finalize only updates them.
func TestJoinOpensEmptyTracks(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	j1, sj1 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-j1"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-sj1")
	j2, j3 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-j2"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-j3")
	id, _ := newRound(cur, j1, sj1, j2, j2, j3, outsider)
	n := tracks.Size()
	joinAll(cur, id, j1, sj1)
	uassert.True(t, tracks.Has(j1.String()) && tracks.Has(sj1.String()), "evaluator and sponsor have records")
	uassert.Equal(t, n+2, tracks.Size())
	joinAll(cur, id, j2, j2) // self-sponsored
	uassert.Equal(t, n+3, tracks.Size(), "one record for a self-sponsored evaluator")
	uassert.False(t, tracks.Has(j3.String()), "listed but not joined: no record")
	for _, a := range []address{j1, sj1, j2} {
		assertTrack(t, a, 0, 0, 0, a.String())
	}

	testing.SkipHeights(11)
	testing.SetRealm(user(j1))
	seq := ProposeRule(cross(cur), id, "weighted", "a:1", 1, "lowest", "")
	testing.SetRealm(user(j2))
	ApproveRule(cross(cur), id, seq)
	testing.SetRealm(user(customer))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, testAppsEncoded(), tSalt)
	assertTrack(t, j1, 0, 0, 0, "counters move only in Finalize")
	sheets(cur, id, j1.String(), "1;2")
	finalizeAs(cur, outsider, id)
	uassert.Equal(t, n+3, tracks.Size(), "Finalize adds no records")
	assertTrack(t, j1, 1, 1, 0, "j1")
	assertTrack(t, sj1, 1, 1, 0, "sj1")
	assertTrack(t, j2, 1, 0, 1, "j2")

	// Joining another round must not reset an existing record.
	id, _ = newRound(cur, j1, sj1)
	joinAll(cur, id, j1, sj1)
	assertTrack(t, j1, 1, 1, 0, "j1 keeps its record")
	assertTrack(t, sj1, 1, 1, 0, "sj1 keeps its record")
}

func TestRejectedJoinOpensNoTrack(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	k1, sk1 := testutils.TestAddress("rep-k1"), testutils.TestAddress("rep-sk1")
	id, _ := newRound(cur, k1, sk1)
	n := tracks.Size()
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "designated sponsor", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, k1) })
	noPay()
	uassert.Equal(t, n, tracks.Size())
}

package grantround

import (
	"chain/runtime"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/g1dxg6leh2vsde83qxcpprvj2xljqz6fg2jp2t08/rulecalc/v1"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

func TestCreateRound(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id, h0 := newRound(cur, e1, s1, e2, s2)
	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.True(t, id > 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, customer, r.Customer)
	uassert.Equal(t, tGrant, r.Grant)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(r.Evaluators))
	uassert.Equal(t, h0+40, r.HScore)
	uassert.Equal(t, h0+50, r.HSheetReveal)
	uassert.True(t, PhaseOf(r, runtime.ChainHeight()) == PhaseJoin, "phase join")
}

func TestCreateRoundRejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	h := runtime.ChainHeight()
	hash := rulecalc.AppsDigest(testApps(), tSalt)
	evs := evList(e1, s1, e2, s2)
	testing.SetRealm(user(customer))

	noPay()
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "grant", func() {
		CreateRound(cross(cur), "g", hash, evs, tBond, tSlash, h+10, h+20, h+30, h+40, h+50)
	})
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(tGrant).Add(chainCoin("uatom", 5)))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "ugnot", func() {
		CreateRound(cross(cur), "g", hash, evs, tBond, tSlash, h+10, h+20, h+30, h+40, h+50)
	})
	cases := []struct {
		name                            string
		hash, evs                       string
		bond, slash                     int64
		hJoin, hRule, hRev, hScore, hSR int64
		want                            string
	}{
		{"slash>bond", hash, evs, 10, 11, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "slash"},
		{"bond 0", hash, evs, 0, 0, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "bond"},
		{"negative slash", hash, evs, 10, -1, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "slash"},
		{"deadlines order", hash, evs, tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 10, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "deadline"},
		{"sheet reveal not after score", hash, evs, tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 40, "deadline"},
		{"join in past", hash, evs, tBond, tSlash, h, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "deadline"},
		{"no evaluators", hash, "", tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "evaluator"},
		{"duplicate evaluator", hash, evList(e1, s1, e1, s2), tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "evaluator"},
		{"invalid evaluator", hash, "nope:" + s1.String(), tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "evaluator"},
		{"missing sponsor", hash, e1.String(), tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "sponsor"},
		{"invalid sponsor", hash, e1.String() + ":nope", tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "sponsor"},
		{"bad hash", "abc", evs, tBond, tSlash, h + 10, h + 20, h + 30, h + 40, h + 50, "hash"},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		pay(tGrant)
		uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, c.want, func() {
			CreateRound(cross(cur), "g", c.hash, c.evs, c.bond, c.slash, c.hJoin, c.hRule, c.hRev, c.hScore, c.hSR)
		}, c.name)
	}
}

func TestJoin(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id, _ := newRound(cur, e1, s1, e2, s2)
	joinAll(cur, id, e1, s1)
	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, s1, r.Sponsors[0])
	uassert.Equal(t, address(""), r.Sponsors[1])
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, r.joined())
}

func TestJoinRejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id, _ := newRound(cur, e1, s1, e2, s2)
	testing.SetRealm(user(s1))

	pay(tBond - 1)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "bond", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e1) }, "short bond")
	testing.SetOriginSend(ugnot(tBond).Add(chainCoin("uatom", 1)))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "ugnot", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e1) }, "extra denom")
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not an evaluator", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, outsider) })

	pay(tBond)
	Join(cross(cur), id, e1)
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already joined", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e1) })

	testing.SkipHeights(11)
	testing.SetRealm(user(s2))
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "join phase", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e2) })
}

func TestJoinOnlyDesignatedSponsor(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id, _ := newRound(cur, e1, s1, e2, s2)
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "designated sponsor", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e1) }, "outsider")
	testing.SetRealm(user(s2))
	pay(tBond)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "designated sponsor", func() { Join(cross(cur), id, e1) }, "another evaluator's sponsor")
	testing.SetRealm(user(s1))
	pay(tBond)
	Join(cross(cur), id, e1)
	uassert.Equal(t, s1, mustGet(id).Sponsors[0])
}

const tSheetSalt = "sheet-salt-sheet-salt-sheet-salt" // exactly 32 characters

func commit(cur realm, id int, ev address, scores string) {
	testing.SetRealm(user(ev))
	CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest(scores, tSheetSalt, ev))
}

func TestSheetDigestKnownVector(t *testing.T) {
	// printf '5,5;6,0|salt|g1evaluator' | sha256sum
	uassert.Equal(t, "d31ec990030b4a0a775ec95b3c125b26569b7b3f1d4d0a2ffd98259c8ccaf129", SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", "salt", address("g1evaluator")))
}

func TestCommitScores(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	hash := SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt, e1)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "64 lowercase hex", func() { CommitScores(cross(cur), id, "abc") }, "not a digest")
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "64 lowercase hex", func() { CommitScores(cross(cur), id, strings.ToUpper(hash)) }, "upper case")
	CommitScores(cross(cur), id, hash)
	uassert.Equal(t, hash, mustGet(id).Commits[0])
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already committed", func() {
		CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest("0,0;0,0", tSheetSalt, e1))
	})
	uassert.Equal(t, hash, mustGet(id).Commits[0], "first commitment kept")
}

func TestCommitScoresOnlyJoinedEvaluator(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "joined evaluator", func() {
		CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest("1,1;1,1", tSheetSalt, outsider))
	})
}

func TestCommitScoresOutsidePhase(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := adoptedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	hash := SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt, e1)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "score phase", func() { CommitScores(cross(cur), id, hash) }, "before the apps are revealed")

	testing.SetRealm(user(customer))
	Reveal(cross(cur), id, testAppsEncoded(), tSalt)
	testing.SkipHeights(30) // past HScore (h0+40)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "score phase", func() { CommitScores(cross(cur), id, hash) }, "after HScore")
}

func openSheet(cur realm, id int, ev address, scores string) {
	testing.SetRealm(user(ev))
	RevealScores(cross(cur), id, scores, tSheetSalt)
}

func TestRevealScores(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "sheet reveal phase", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) }, "before HScore")
	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Sheets[0] == nil, "nothing revealed early")

	testing.SkipHeights(30) // past HScore (h0+40)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "do not match", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tWrong) }, "wrong salt")
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "do not match", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,1", tSheetSalt) }, "other scores")
	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Sheets[0] == nil, "state unchanged after rejected reveals")
	RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt)
	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.Equal(t, e1, r.Sheets[0].Evaluator)
	uassert.Equal(t, 6, r.Sheets[0].Scores[1][0])
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already revealed", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) })
}

func TestRevealScoresCopiedHash(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e2)) // e2 copies e1's public hash
	CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt, e1))
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	openSheet(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0") // scores and salt are now public
	testing.SetRealm(user(e2))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "do not match", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) }, "copied hash")
	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Sheets[1] == nil, "copied hash stays closed")
}

func TestRevealScoresInvalidSheet(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "11,0;0,0")
	commit(cur, id, e2, "5,5")
	commit(cur, id, e3, "a,b;c,d")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "invalid scores", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "11,0;0,0", tSheetSalt) }, "out of range")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e2))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "invalid scores", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5", tSheetSalt) }, "missing app")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e3))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "invalid scores", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "a,b;c,d", tSheetSalt) }, "not numbers")
}

func TestRevealScoresWithoutCommit(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "no committed scores", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) })
	testing.SetRealm(user(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "joined evaluator", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) })
}

func TestRevealScoresAfterDeadline(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SkipHeights(40) // past HSheetReveal (h0+50)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "sheet reveal phase", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt) })
}

func TestRevealScoresAtDeadline(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	commit(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SkipHeights(39) // h0+50 == HSheetReveal
	openSheet(cur, id, e1, "5,5;6,0")
	uassert.True(t, mustGet(id).Sheets[0] != nil, "the deadline block still counts")
}

// The short salt opens the commitment, so only the length can reject it.
func TestRevealScoresShortSalt(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, 32, len(tSheetSalt))
	id := revealedRound(cur, 2, "lowest")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt[:31], e1))
	testing.SetRealm(user(e2))
	CommitScores(cross(cur), id, SheetDigest("5,5;6,0", "", e2))
	commit(cur, id, e3, "5,5;6,0")
	testing.SkipHeights(30)
	testing.SetRealm(user(e1))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "salt too short", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", tSheetSalt[:31]) }, "31")
	testing.SetRealm(user(e2))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "salt too short", func() { RevealScores(cross(cur), id, "5,5;6,0", "") }, "empty")
	openSheet(cur, id, e3, "5,5;6,0")
	r := mustGet(id)
	uassert.True(t, r.Sheets[0] == nil && r.Sheets[1] == nil, "short salts stay closed")
	uassert.True(t, r.Sheets[2] != nil, "32 characters are enough")
}

files.body:
package trickle

import (
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
)

func mk(t *testing.T, deposit, start, cliff, end int64, cancelable bool) Stream {
	t.Helper()
	s, err := New(alice, bob, deposit, start, cliff, end, cancelable)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	return s
}

func checkInvariant(t *testing.T, s Stream, now int64) {
	t.Helper()
	sum := s.Withdrawn + s.Withdrawable(now) + s.Refundable(now) + s.Refunded
	if sum != s.Deposit {
		t.Fatalf("invariant broken at %d: %d != %d", now, sum, s.Deposit)
	}
	if s.Withdrawable(now) < 0 || s.Refundable(now) < 0 {
		t.Fatalf("negative balance at %d", now)
	}
}

func TestNewValidation(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name                       string
		from, to                   address
		deposit, start, cliff, end int64
		want                       error
	}{
		{"zero deposit", alice, bob, 0, 0, 0, 10, ErrZeroDeposit},
		{"negative deposit", alice, bob, -5, 0, 0, 10, ErrZeroDeposit},
		{"bad recipient", alice, address("nope"), 1, 0, 0, 10, ErrBadAddress},
		{"self", alice, alice, 1, 0, 0, 10, ErrSelfStream},
		{"zero duration", alice, bob, 1, 10, 10, 10, ErrBadSchedule},
		{"cliff before start", alice, bob, 1, 10, 5, 20, ErrBadSchedule},
		{"cliff after end", alice, bob, 1, 10, 30, 20, ErrBadSchedule},
		{"negative start", alice, bob, 1, -1, 0, 20, ErrBadSchedule},
		{"too long", alice, bob, 1, 0, 0, MaxDuration + 1, ErrTooLong},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		_, err := New(c.from, c.to, c.deposit, c.start, c.cliff, c.end, true)
		uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, c.want, c.name)
	}
}

func TestLinearVesting(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 1000, 100, 100, 200, true)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Vested(50))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Vested(100))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10), s.Vested(101))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), s.Vested(150))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(990), s.Vested(199))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), s.Vested(200))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), s.Vested(1<<40))
	for now := int64(0); now < 300; now += 7 {
		checkInvariant(t, s, now)
	}
}

func TestCliff(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 1000, 0, 250, 1000, true)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Vested(249))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(250), s.Vested(250)) // cliff releases the backlog
	uassert.Equal(t, Cliffed.String(), s.Status(10).String())
	uassert.Equal(t, Streaming.String(), s.Status(250).String())
}

func TestRoundingNeverOverpays(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 7, 0, 0, 3, true)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), s.Vested(1))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4), s.Vested(2))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(7), s.Vested(3))
}

func TestHugeAmountsDoNotOverflow(t *testing.T) {
	const max = int64(1<<63 - 1)
	s := mk(t, max, 0, 0, MaxDuration, true)
	uassert.Equal(t, max/2, s.Vested(MaxDuration/2))
	uassert.Equal(t, max, s.Vested(MaxDuration))
	checkInvariant(t, s, MaxDuration-1)
}

func TestWithdraw(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 1000, 0, 0, 100, true)

	_, err := s.Withdraw(0, 0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNothingToPay)

	paid, err := s.Withdraw(30, 100)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100), paid)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(200), s.Withdrawable(30))

	_, err = s.Withdraw(30, 201)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrOverWithdraw)
	_, err = s.Withdraw(30, -1)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrBadAmount)

	paid, err = s.Withdraw(30, 0)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(200), paid)
	checkInvariant(t, s, 30)

	paid, err = s.Withdraw(500, 0)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(700), paid)
	uassert.Equal(t, Settled.String(), s.Status(500).String())
	checkInvariant(t, s, 500)
}

func TestCancelSplitsDeposit(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 1000, 0, 0, 100, true)
	_, err := s.Withdraw(20, 0)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)

	toR, toS, err := s.CancelBySender(60)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(400), toR)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(400), toS)
	uassert.Equal(t, Canceled.String(), s.Status(60).String())

	// Frozen: time passing changes nothing, nothing left to claim.
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Withdrawable(1000))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), s.Refundable(1000))
	checkInvariant(t, s, 1000)

	_, _, err = s.Cancel(70)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrCanceled)
	_, err = s.Withdraw(70, 0)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNothingToPay)
}

func TestCancelBeforeCliffRefundsEverything(t *testing.T) {
	s := mk(t, 1000, 0, 50, 100, true)
	toR, toS, err := s.CancelBySender(49)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), toR)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), toS)
}

func TestCancelRules(t *testing.T) {
	locked := mk(t, 1000, 0, 0, 100, false)
	_, _, err := locked.CancelBySender(10)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrNotCancelable)

	// The recipient may still walk away from a non-cancelable stream.
	toR, toS, err := locked.Cancel(10)
	uassert.NoError(t, err)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100), toR)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(900), toS)

	done := mk(t, 1000, 0, 0, 100, true)
	_, _, err = done.CancelBySender(100)
	uassert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrEnded)
}

func TestRatePerDay(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1000), mk(t, 30000, 0, 0, 30*86400, true).RatePerDay())
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), mk(t, 500, 0, 0, 60, true).RatePerDay())
}

package trickle

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

var (
	alice = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob   = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol = testutils.TestAddress("carol")

	realmAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g1a04glq8w6ts7r9yzyznpa99qkzwp8pewcf3aef/trickle")
)

// send attaches ugnot to the next call the way the chain does: the coins
// land at the realm address before the function runs. testing.SetRealm only
// affects the frame that calls it, so each test sets the caller itself.
func send(addr address, ugnot int64) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(addr)
	if ugnot > 0 {
		coins := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin("ugnot", ugnot))
		testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
		testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, coins)
	} else {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	}
}

func setTime(unix int64) {
	ctx := testing.GetContext()
	ctx.Time = time.Unix(unix, 0)
	testing.SetContext(ctx)
}

func balance(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, "ugnot")
}

func TestLifecycle(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setTime(1_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 1_000_000)
	id := Create(cross(cur), bob, 0, 0, 1000, true, "salary")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Withdrawable(id))

	setTime(1_000_250)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(250_000), Withdrawable(id))

	// Only the recipient withdraws.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	send(carol, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the recipient", func() { Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0) })

	before := balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	send(bob, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100_000), Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 100_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(150_000), Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0))
	uassert.Equal(t, before+250_000, balance(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "nothing to withdraw", func() { Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0) })

	// Sender cancels at 60%: recipient gets the unclaimed 35%, sender 40%.
	setTime(1_000_600)
	aliceBefore, bobBefore := balance(alice), balance(bob)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 0)
	Cancel(cross(cur), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, aliceBefore+400_000, balance(alice))
	uassert.Equal(t, bobBefore+350_000, balance(bob))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "already canceled", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(StreamJSON(id), `"status":"canceled"`))
}

func TestCliffAndFullWithdraw(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setTime(2_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 500)
	id := Create(cross(cur), bob, 2_000_100, 50, 100, false, "")

	setTime(2_000_149)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), Withdrawable(id))
	setTime(2_000_150)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(250), Withdrawable(id))

	// Non-cancelable: the sender is locked in.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not cancelable", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })

	setTime(2_000_999)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	send(bob, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(StreamJSON(id), `"status":"settled"`))
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "fully vested", func() { Cancel(cross(cur), id) })
}

func TestTransfer(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setTime(3_000_000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 1000)
	id := Create(cross(cur), bob, 0, 0, 100, true, "")

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the recipient", func() { Transfer(cross(cur), id, carol) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	send(bob, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "must differ", func() { Transfer(cross(cur), id, alice) })
	Transfer(cross(cur), id, carol)

	setTime(3_000_050)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "only the recipient", func() { Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	send(carol, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(500), Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 0))

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(IncomingJSON(carol, 0, 10), `"deposit":1000`))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(IncomingJSON(bob, 0, 10), `"deposit":1000,`))
}

func TestCreateBatch(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setTime(4_000_000)
	list := bob.String() + ":300, " + carol.String() + ":700"

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 999)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "more than", func() { CreateBatch(cross(cur), list, 0, 0, 100, true, "payroll") })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 1001)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "less than", func() { CreateBatch(cross(cur), list, 0, 0, 100, true, "payroll") })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 1000)
	n := Count()
	ids := CreateBatch(cross(cur), list, 0, 0, 100, true, "payroll")
	uassert.Equal(t, n+2, Count())
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(strings.Split(ids, ",")))

	setTime(4_000_100)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	send(carol, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(700), Withdraw(cross(cur), uint64(Count()), 0))
}

func TestCreateValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	setTime(5_000_000)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	send(alice, 0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "send ugnot", func() { Create(cross(cur), bob, 0, 0, 100, true, "") })

	Hide(cross(cur), p2, "spoilers")
	hidden := PassageJSON(p3)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(hidden, `"passage":{"id":3,"tale":1,"hidden":true}`), hidden)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(hidden, body), "hidden body is not served")
	reason := PassageJSON(p2)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(reason, `"reason":"spoilers"`), reason)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(PassageJSON(1), `"Go left"`), "hidden choice is not listed")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(TaleJSON(1), `"Go left"`), "hidden branch is not in the outline")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(BardJSON(bob.String()), `"Stop here"`), "hidden passages leave the bard page")

	Hide(cross(cur), 1, "")
	ht := TaleJSON(1)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(ht, `"title":""`), ht)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(ht, `"opening"`), ht)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(TalesJSON(1, 10), "Quotes"), "hidden tale title is not listed")
}

package taletree

import (

	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/urequire/v0"
)

var (
	alice   = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob     = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol   = testutils.TestAddress("carol")
	dave    = testutils.TestAddress("dave")
	keeperA = testutils.TestAddress("keeper")

	opening = "The tavern fire is low and a stranger in a grey hood sits down at your table."
	body    = "Something happens next, and it is long enough to be a passage."
)

func resetState() {
	taleSeq = 0
	passageSeq = 0
	tales = avl.Tree{}
	passages = avl.Tree{}
	cheers = avl.Tree{}
	bards = avl.Tree{}
	bardPassages = avl.Tree{}
	fame = avl.Tree{}
	totalTips = 0
	paused = false
	keeper = ownable.NewWithAddress(keeperA)
}

func TestStartTale(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))

	tid := StartTale(cross(cur), "  The Grey   Stranger ", opening)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, tid)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, TaleCount())
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, PassageCount())
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, BardCount())

	tv, ok := GetTale(tid)
	urequire.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, "The Grey Stranger", tv.Title, "title is trimmed and spaces folded")
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, tv.Narrator)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, tv.Root)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, tv.Passages)

	pv, ok := GetPassage(tv.Root)
	urequire.True(t, ok)
	uassert.Equal(t, opening, pv.Body)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, pv.Depth)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, pv.Parent)
	uassert.Equal(t, alice, pv.Author)

	b, _ := getBard(alice)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, b.Tales)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, b.Passages)

	// A second tale gets the next ids.
	tid2 := StartTale(cross(cur), "Second tale", opening)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, tid2)
	tv2, _ := GetTale(tid2)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, tv2.Root)
}

func TestStartTaleValidation(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))

	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTitleLength.Error(), func() { StartTale(cross(cur), "ab", opening) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTitleLength.Error(), func() { StartTale(cross(cur), strings.Repeat("x", MaxTitleLen+1), opening) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrBodyLength.Error(), func() { StartTale(cross(cur), "Title", "too short") })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrBodyLength.Error(), func() { StartTale(cross(cur), "Title", strings.Repeat("x", MaxBodyLen+1)) })
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, TaleCount(), "failed calls leave no state")
}

func TestBranchAndEnding(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	tid := StartTale(cross(cur), "The Grey Stranger", opening)
	root := 1

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	a := Branch(cross(cur), root, "Ask the stranger's name", body)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, a)
	e := WriteEnding(cross(cur), root, "Leave the tavern", body)
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, e)

	pa, _ := GetPassage(a)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, pa.Depth)
	uassert.Equal(t, root, pa.Parent)
	uassert.Equal(t, "Ask the stranger's name", pa.Choice)
	uassert.False(t, pa.Ending)
	pe, _ := GetPassage(e)
	uassert.True(t, pe.Ending)

	pr, _ := GetPassage(root)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(pr.Children))
	tv, _ := GetTale(tid)
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, tv.Passages)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, tv.Endings)

	// Endings have no choices.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrIsEnding.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), e, "Come back", body) })
	// Sibling choices must differ, ignoring case.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrDuplicateChoice.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), root, "ask the STRANGER'S name", body) })
	// Unknown parent.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrPassageNotFound.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), 99, "Nowhere", body) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrPassageNotFound.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), 0, "Nowhere", body) })
	// Length checks.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrChoiceLength.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), root, "go", body) })
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrBodyLength.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), root, "Go on", "short") })

	// Gnokey sends newlines as the two characters `\n`.
	nl := Branch(cross(cur), a, "Listen", `First line.\nSecond line of the passage.`)
	pn, _ := GetPassage(nl)
	uassert.Equal(t, "First line.\nSecond line of the passage.", pn.Body)
}

func TestMaxChoices(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	StartTale(cross(cur), "Crowded room", opening)
	for i := 0; i < MaxChoices; i++ {
		Branch(cross(cur), 1, "Door number "+string(rune('A'+i)), body)
	}
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTooManyChoices.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), 1, "One door too many", body) })
}

func TestMaxDepth(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	StartTale(cross(cur), "A long road", opening)
	parent := 1
	for d := 1; d < MaxDepth; d++ {
		parent = Branch(cross(cur), parent, "Keep walking", body)
	}
	p, _ := GetPassage(parent)
	uassert.Equal(t, MaxDepth-1, p.Depth)

	// The last level only takes endings.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTooDeep.Error(), func() { Branch(cross(cur), parent, "Walk further", body) })
	end := WriteEnding(cross(cur), parent, "Arrive at last", body)
	pe, _ := GetPassage(end)
	uassert.Equal(t, MaxDepth, pe.Depth)

	// The canon walks the whole road.
	uassert.Equal(t, MaxDepth+1, len(CanonPath(1)))
}

func TestCheerAndCanon(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	StartTale(cross(cur), "Two doors", opening)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	left := Branch(cross(cur), 1, "Take the left door", body)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	right := Branch(cross(cur), 1, "Take the right door", body)

	// Tie: the earliest passage wins.
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1 2]", ufmtInts(CanonPath(1)))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Cheer(cross(cur), right)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1 3]", ufmtInts(CanonPath(1)))
	uassert.True(t, HasCheered(right, alice))
	uassert.False(t, HasCheered(left, alice))

	// Once per address, never your own.
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrAlreadyCheered.Error(), func() { Cheer(cross(cur), right) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrSelfCheer.Error(), func() { Cheer(cross(cur), right) })

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(dave))
	Cheer(cross(cur), left)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	Cheer(cross(cur), left)
	uassert.Equal(t, "[1 2]", ufmtInts(CanonPath(1)), "left now has 2 cheers against 1")

	tv, _ := GetTale(1)
	uassert.Equal(t, 3, tv.Cheers)

	// Hall of fame: bob (2 cheers) before carol (1).
	var order []address
	fame.Iterate("", "", func(_ string, v any) bool {
		order = append(order, v.(address))
		return false
	})
	urequire.True(t, len(order) >= 2)
	uassert.Equal(t, bob, order[0])
	uassert.Equal(t, carol, order[1])
	bb, _ := getBard(bob)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, bb.Cheers)
	uassert.Equal(t, bards.Size(), fame.Size(), "one fame entry per bard")
}

func TestTip(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	StartTale(cross(cur), "Paid in coin", opening)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pid := Branch(cross(cur), 1, "Pay the bard", body)

	realmAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land" + base)
	bnk := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	before := bnk.GetCoin(bob, "ugnot")

	// The coins of a maketx call land on the realm before the call runs.
	tip := chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 1_500_000}}
	testing.IssueCoins(realmAddr, tip)
	testing.SetOriginSend(tip)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	Tip(cross(cur), pid)

	uassert.Equal(t, before+1_500_000, bnk.GetCoin(bob, "ugnot"), "author got the whole tip")
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), bnk.GetCoin(realmAddr, "ugnot"), "the realm keeps nothing")
	pv, _ := GetPassage(pid)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), pv.Tips)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), TotalTips())
	bb, _ := getBard(bob)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1_500_000), bb.Tips)

	// Self tips, empty tips and other denoms are refused.
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrSelfTip.Error(), func() { Tip(cross(cur), pid) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTipAmount.Error(), func() { Tip(cross(cur), pid) })
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ufoo", Amount: 5}})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTipAmount.Error(), func() { Tip(cross(cur), pid) })
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ufoo", Amount: 5}, {Denom: "ugnot", Amount: 5}})
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTipAmount.Error(), func() { Tip(cross(cur), pid) })

	// A code realm in between could have spent the coins: refused.
	testing.SetOriginSend(tip)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewCodeRealm("gno.land/r/someone/middleman"))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, ErrTipCaller.Error(), func() { Tip(cross(cur), pid) })
}

func TestHideAndUnhide(cur realm, t *testing.T) {

func TestRenderPages(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	home := Render("")

	fameP := Render("bards")

	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("p/99"), "There is no such passage"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("tale/x"), "There is no such tale"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("bard/nope"), "There is no such bard"))

func TestRenderSanitizesUserText(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	evilTitle := `# Pwned <gno-button href="/r/evil$help&func=Drain" label="Claim" />`
	evilBody := "## Fake heading\n<gno-button href=\"/r/evil\" label=\"x\" />\n[a normal link](https://gno.land) stays."
	StartTale(cross(cur), evilTitle, evilBody)

	// Every copy of the injected tag must be backslash-escaped, so it
	// renders as literal text: drop the escaped copies, none may remain.
	home := Render("")
	page := Render("p/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, `\<gno\-button href="/r/evil`), "title copy is escaped text")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, `\<gno-button href="/r/evil`), "body copy is escaped text")
	for _, out := range []string{home, page} {
		stripped := strings.ReplaceAll(out, `\<`, "")
		uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(stripped, `<gno-button href="/r/evil`), "no live injected button")
		uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(stripped, `<gno\-button`), "no live injected button")
	}
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(page, "\n## Fake heading"), "no heading injection")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(page, "[a normal link](https://gno.land)"), "inline links survive")
}

func TestRenderHiddenAndPaging(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	resetState()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	for i := 0; i < talesPerPage+2; i++ {
		StartTale(cross(cur), "Tale number "+string(rune('A'+i)), opening)
	}
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "Tale number L"), "newest first")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(home, "Tale number A"), "oldest on page 2")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "?page=2"), home)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("?page=2"), "Tale number A"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	p := Branch(cross(cur), 1, "A choice to hide", body)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	Hide(cross(cur), p, "spam")
	hidden := Render("p/" + itoa(p))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(hidden, "was hidden by a moderator. Reason: spam"), hidden)
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(hidden, body))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(Render("tale/1"), "A choice to hide"))

	// Hiding an opening hides the tale's title from the home list too.
	Hide(cross(cur), 1, "abuse")
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(Render("?page=2"), "Tale number A"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("?page=2"), "Hidden tale"))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(Render("tale/1"), "This tale was hidden by a moderator"))
}

func TestGnotFormat(t *testing.T) {
	uassert.Equal(t, "0 GNOT", gnot(0))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1 GNOT", gnot(1_000_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "1.5 GNOT", gnot(1_500_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "2.05 GNOT", gnot(2_050_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "0.01 GNOT", gnot(10_000))
	uassert.Equal(t, "0 GNOT", gnot(9_999))
}

func ufmtInts(ids []int) string {
	parts := make([]string, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		parts[i] = itoa(id)
	}
	return "[" + strings.Join(parts, " ") + "]"
}

func itoa(n int) string {
	if n == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	s := ""
	for n > 0 {
		s = string(rune('0'+n%10)) + s
		n /= 10
	}
	return s
}

	bankAddr := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/g132vz03ycpaagtef4jmxjakstkppgyc5wn3r807/erratabank/v1")

	otherSponsor := chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/test/escrowv1sponsor")

	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 250)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	id := erratabank.CreateBook(cross(cur), "Quickstart", "First", "https://example.org/guide", 1000)
	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 1100)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	book, _ := erratabank.GetBook(id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(reader))
	paid := erratabank.Submit(cross(cur), id, "Page 1", "First correction.")
	submittedEarlier := erratabank.Submit(cross(cur), id, "Page 2", "Second submission.")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(readerTwo))
	acceptedEarlier := erratabank.Submit(cross(cur), id, "Page 3", "Third submission.")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	erratabank.Accept(cross(cur), paid, "")
	book, _ = erratabank.GetBook(id)
	println("sponsor payout, owner, sponsor, realm, finder:", book.OwnerFunds, book.SponsorFunds,
		bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"), bank.GetCoin(reader, "ugnot"))

	erratabank.Accept(cross(cur), acceptedEarlier, "")
	erratabank.Accept(cross(cur), submittedEarlier, "")
	book, _ = erratabank.GetBook(id)
	println("unfunded rewards and realm:", book.Owed, bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"))
	println("reserved withdrawal:", revive(func() { erratabank.Withdraw(cross(cur), id, 1) }))

	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 650)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), id)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	book, _ = erratabank.GetBook(id)
	println("first accepted debt settled, owed, realm, finders:", book.Owed, bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"),
		bank.GetCoin(reader, "ugnot"), bank.GetCoin(readerTwo, "ugnot"))

	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 1250)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), id)
	report, _ := erratabank.GetErratum(submittedEarlier)
	stats := erratabank.FinderStats(reader)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	book, _ = erratabank.GetBook(id)
	println("second debt settled, owner, owed, report paid, finder paid, finder owed:", book.OwnerFunds,
		book.Owed, report.Paid, stats.Paid, stats.Owed)
	println("finder bank balance:", bank.GetCoin(reader, "ugnot"))

	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 500)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), id)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(otherSponsor))

	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)

	println("owner withdrawal, owner funds, sponsor funds, realm, owner balance:", book.OwnerFunds,
		book.SponsorFunds, bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"), bank.GetCoin(owner, "ugnot"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))

		erratabank.SponsorBalance(id, otherSponsor), bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"))
	println("refund replay:", revive(func() { erratabank.RefundSponsor(cross(cur), id) }))
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(otherSponsor))
	erratabank.RefundSponsor(cross(cur), id)
	book, _ = erratabank.GetBook(id)
	println("refund to second sponsor, sponsor funds, realm:", bank.GetCoin(otherSponsor, "ugnot"),
		book.SponsorFunds, bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"))

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	closedID := erratabank.CreateBook(cross(cur), "Close with debt", "First", "https://example.org/guide", 1000)
	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 300)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), closedID)
	testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(reader))
	closedReportID := erratabank.Submit(cross(cur), closedID, "Page 1", "Payable before closure.")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	erratabank.Accept(cross(cur), closedReportID, "")
	erratabank.SetBookOpen(cross(cur), closedID, false)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	println("refund while finder is owed:", revive(func() { erratabank.RefundSponsor(cross(cur), closedID) }))
	stageSend(cur, bankAddr, 700)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(owner))
	erratabank.FundBook(cross(cur), closedID)
	closedBook, _ := erratabank.GetBook(closedID)
	println("closed book settled, open, owed, realm, finder:", closedBook.Open, closedBook.Owed,
		bank.GetCoin(bankAddr, "ugnot"), bank.GetCoin(reader, "ugnot"))
}

// Reproduce the VM's transfer and origin-send envelope before MsgCall.
func stageSend(cur realm, target address, amount int64) {
	sent := chain.NewCoins(chain.NewCoin("ugnot", amount))
	testing.IssueCoins(cur.Address(), sent)
	b := banker.NewBanker(banker.BankerTypeRealmSend, cur)
	b.SendCoins(cur.Address(), target, sent)
	testing.SetOriginSend(sent)
}
